name: PT Darma Henwa Tbk
summary: PT Darma Henwa Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the mining support and other excavation activities, and metal fabrication products in Indonesia. It operates in two segments, Mining Services and Other Services. The company is involved in various mining activities, including land clearing, top soiling, drilling, blasting, overburden removal and dumping, coal getting, run of mine, transportation, hauling, barging, vegetation, and rehabilitation. It also engages in road and bridge construction, mineral dressing plant installation, earthworks, drilling exploration, and civil consultant management activities, as well as rental and operating lease of industrial machinery and equipmen…
